Name: Siddharth Xyz
Question: What are you thinking about?
Answer: I'm thinking about Quora. When I started using Quora during the lockdown, I was fascinated by it. There were people with diverse backgrounds sharing their experiences. But nowadays, it is disappointing me. In the old days, people used to share their real-life experiences, their perspectives on anything and everything, their ways of thinking, how they perceived the world, and their life lessons. But nowadays, I rarely find any new writers doing so. All the new users on Quora just don't express themselves or their thought processes. Instead, they just post random, useless things throughout the day. They prefer quantity over quality in their posts. Due to this, to read something sensible, to read something good, I have to rely on old answers. But how long will this go on? How long will people have to depend on old answers instead of new writers' posts? I don't consider myself a good writer. I'm also just like any other Quora user who came here to read something good in their free time. I'm sorry if i hurted someone's sentiments. ( Image: Gallery) ~ Siddharth Xyz

Name: Siddharth Xyz
Question: Would you like to visit the past or the future?
Answer: I want to visit both. I want to go back to my school and befriend those people who have stayed until now. I want to seize all the opportunities that I missed during my school days and enjoy that golden period with the same energy. I want to roam freely with my childhood friends through the streets on hot summer days, stress-free, without needing to worry about the future, and laugh with them at all the silly things once again. I want to visit my future so that I can learn from it and take preventive steps in present time to improve my future self. And, of course, I want to see whether I remain single in the future or, if not, then who my partner is there 😋. (Image : pinterest)

Name: Siddharth Xyz
Question: Some people likes to click photos, some like to enjoy the view. Which of them is enjoying life more?
Answer: Have you ever pondered what will endure after many years when you reflect on your life, having achieved so much that you once dreamed of? The only things that will remain are memories, both good and bad. In day-to-day life, people stress and overthink about petty things, like today the teacher scolded me, he said this sarcastically, that person commented negatively on my post, etc. But you should ask yourself, do these things affect your life even one percent after 5 years? The answer is clearly no. You've often heard that we should live in the moment and refrain from taking pictures. People romanticize the idea that we should immerse ourselves in experiences rather than through the lens of a camera. However, I disagree. To me, “pictures are like window frames through which we can peer back into memories. They serve as tangible reminders, easily reconnecting us with the circumstances and sequences of events”. Without them, there's a chance we might forget about it. So, yes click pictures!!! Edit: photo removed
